bio.text: Jose Cabrera joined the WOS team in February of 2016 as a Talent Acquisition Associate and is currently serving as the Associate Director of Talent Acquisition. Jose joined the Marine Corp Reserve after the tragic events of 9/11. During this time, he deployed to Iraq twice in 2003 and 2005. Jose then used his Post 9/11 G.I. Bill to complete his Bachelor’s of Arts in History, while also completing a Teacher Certification Program at Hunter College.
